casaMango.about:
Casa Mango is an exclusive escape designed for comfort, space, and connection. Its private setting and relaxed atmosphere make it the perfect destination for groups and families seeking to share unforgettable moments in a refined and natural environment.

Villa Mango also includes a game room for entertainment, a spacious yoga deck surrounded by nature, and open social areas that invite guests to unwind and enjoy time together. It's an ideal retreat for experiencing Costa Rica in a refined yet natural way.

goodToKnow.title: Our villas are located in a pristine mountain environment, and part of the magic of staying here comes with a few things worth keeping in mind to ensure a comfortable experience.

meshDoors.title: Mesh Doors and Windows
meshDoors.description: Our villas are equipped with mesh screens on doors and windows to keep insects out. We kindly ask that you keep them closed at all times, especially in the evenings, to ensure a comfortable and bug-free stay.

powerOutages.title: Power Outages
powerOutages.description: Due to our remote mountain location, occasional brief power outages may occur. We recommend keeping your phone charged and having a flashlight handy, both of which are available at the villa.

transportation.title: Transportation
transportation.description: A 4x4 vehicle is highly recommended to access the villa and surrounding areas safely and comfortably.

foodStorage.title: Food Storage
foodStorage.description: We ask that all food be stored in the refrigerator or in sealed containers when not in use. Leaving food out in the kitchen or common areas can attract wildlife, which is a natural part of our mountain ecosystem but best admired from a distance.

nighttimeLighting.title: Nighttime Lighting
nighttimeLighting.description: We provide exterior lighting along pathways for your safety. Please keep in mind that lights left on unnecessarily at night tend to attract insects, so we suggest turning off any lights in rooms or terraces that are not in use, and keeping doors and windows closed.
